examples.en: I caught a cold and groaned in pain all night.

examples.ko: 혼자 끙끙 고민하지 말고 말해 주세요.
examples.en: Don't agonize alone; please tell me.

examples.ko: 무거운 짐을 들고 끙끙 계단을 올라갔어요.
examples.en: I carried a heavy load and grunted up the stairs.

examples.ko: 아이가 어려운 문제를 풀려고 끙끙 애를 써요.
examples.en: The child struggles hard to solve a difficult problem.
The puppy makes whimpering sounds as if it's in pain.

examples.ko: 속으로 끙끙 참지 말고 병원에 가세요.
examples.en: Don't just suffer silently; go to the hospital.

explain: 힘들거나 아파서 내는 낮은 소리를 흉내 낸 말이에요. 몸이 아플 때뿐 아니라 걱정을 혼자 안고 있을 때도 '끙끙 앓다'처럼 써요.

phrases.example: 그 일을 혼자 끙끙 앓지 말고 친구한테 얘기해 보세요.
phrases.en: Don't stew over that alone; talk to a friend about it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 몸이 아파서 앓는 것뿐 아니라, 걱정을 말하지 못하고 혼자 속으로 고민할 때도 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Besides being physically ill, it means worrying silently by yourself without telling anyone.

explain_en: It imitates the low sound made when something is hard or painful. It is used for physical pain and also, as in '끙끙 앓다', for carrying a worry alone.

examples.en: A whole clump of my hair fell out.
A wad of receipts came out of the drawer.
She tore off the bread in big chunks and gave it to me.
I swept up the fallen leaves one big pile at a time.
I went to the store holding a wad of cash.
I put the laundry into the washing machine in one big lump.

explain: 한데 뭉쳐 있는 덩어리를 가리키고 '한 뭉텅이'처럼 양을 셀 때도 써요. '덩어리'보다 입말에 가깝고, 꽤 많은 양이 한꺼번에 뭉쳐 있다는 느낌이 있어요. '뭉텅이로', '뭉텅이째'처럼 조사나 접미사와 함께 자주 나와요.

phrases.en: I came carrying a big bundle of laundry.
phrases.nuance_ko: 양을 셀 때 '한 뭉텅이'로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used as a counting phrase for one bundle.

phrases.en: I threw away the unused documents in a big bunch.
phrases.nuance_ko: 한꺼번에 많이 다룰 때 조사 '로'를 붙여 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: With the particle 로, it means handling a lot at once.

phrases.en: Hair fell out in clumps.
phrases.nuance_ko: 덩어리 그대로라는 뜻으로 '-째'를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: The suffix -째 means 'as a whole lump.'

explain_en: It points to a clump of things stuck together, and is also used to count amounts as in '한 뭉텅이'. It is more colloquial than '덩어리' and suggests a fairly large amount bunched together. It often appears with particles or suffixes, as in '뭉텅이로' and '뭉텅이째'.

examples.en: The doctors are performing an autopsy on the body.
The police performed an autopsy on the deceased yesterday.
To find the cause, an autopsy has to be done.
The family waited outside while the autopsy was going on.

examples.ko: 동물을 부검하고 나서 병의 이유를 알았어요.
examples.en: After the animal was autopsied, we learned the reason for the illness.
I heard the autopsy will be done tomorrow.

explain: '부검하다' 앞에는 '시신을', '사망자를'이 오고, 가끔 '동물을'도 와요. '부검을 하다'라고 풀어 말해도 같아요.

phrases.example: 경찰이 사망 원인을 알려고 부검을 해요.
phrases.en: The police conduct an autopsy to find the cause of death.
phrases.nuance_ko: '부검하다'를 풀어 쓴 말로, 뜻은 같고 '부검'을 강조할 때 좋아요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is the spread-out form of '부검하다' with the same meaning; it puts a little more focus on the autopsy itself.

phrases.example: 부검 결과가 다음 주에 나올 거예요.
phrases.en: The autopsy results will come out next week.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뉴스에서 '부검'과 함께 가장 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is the most common phrase paired with autopsy in the news.

phrases.example: 가족이 원하지 않아서 시신을 부검하지 않았어요.
phrases.en: They did not conduct an autopsy because the family did not want one.
phrases.nuance_ko: 부정형이라서 부검이 이루어지지 않았을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: This negative form is used when an autopsy was not carried out.

explain_en: Before 부검하다 you usually find '시신을' or '사망자를', and sometimes '동물을'. You can also split it into '부검을 하다' with the same meaning.

examples.en: A snail leaves a secretion where it has crawled.

examples.ko: 눈에 분비물이 많이 나와서 병원에 갔어요.
examples.en: A lot of discharge came out of my eye, so I went to the hospital.

examples.ko: 이 식물은 잎에서 나오는 분비물로 벌레를 쫓아요.
examples.en: This plant drives off insects with a secretion from its leaves.

examples.ko: 상처에서 노란 분비물이 계속 나오면 의사에게 보여 주세요.
examples.en: If yellow discharge keeps coming out of the wound, show it to a doctor.

examples.ko: 고양이 털과 분비물 때문에 알레르기가 생길 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can get allergies from cat hair and secretions.
I took a class that studies animal secretions.

explain: 눈곱, 콧물, 땀, 침처럼 몸에서 나오는 것을 묶어서 부르는 말이에요. 병원이나 생물 수업에서 많이 쓰고, 일상에서는 '눈곱', '콧물'처럼 구체적으로 말해요. 동사는 '분비되다'예요.

phrases.en: Discharge is coming out of the wound.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병원에서 몸 상태를 설명할 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used to describe symptoms at the hospital.

phrases.en: I wiped off the discharge with clean gauze.
phrases.nuance_ko: 몸에서 나온 것을 닦아 낼 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when wiping away what came out of the body.

phrases.en: Hormones are secreted when you are nervous.
phrases.nuance_ko: '분비물'과 짝이 되는 동사로, 몸에서 나오는 일을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The paired verb, meaning something is released from the body.

explain_en: It is a collective term for things that come out of a body, such as eye gunk, snot, sweat and saliva. It is common at hospitals and in biology class, while in daily life people name the specific thing like '눈곱' or '콧물'. The related verb is '분비되다'.

examples.en: At the dentist, they applied fluoride to my teeth.
This toothpaste contains fluoride.

examples.ko: 불소는 충치를 막는 데 도움이 된다고 해요.
examples.en: They say fluoride helps prevent cavities.

examples.ko: 아이들 치약은 불소 함량을 꼭 확인해야 해요.
examples.en: For children's toothpaste, you must check the fluoride content.

examples.ko: 불소 없는 치약도 있으니 성분을 확인해 보세요.
examples.en: There is toothpaste without fluoride too, so check the ingredients.

examples.ko: 불소 도포를 받은 뒤에는 30분 동안 먹지 말라고 했어요.
examples.en: They told me not to eat for 30 minutes after the fluoride treatment.

explain: 화학에서는 원소 F를 가리키지만, 일상에서는 치약과 충치 이야기에서 가장 많이 들어요. '플루오린'도 같은 원소를 가리키는 이름이에요. 치약 성분표에서는 '불소'라고 적힌 걸 볼 수 있어요.

phrases.en: I bought fluoride toothpaste for my child.
phrases.nuance_ko: 충치를 막는 치약을 말할 때 가장 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common collocation, for toothpaste that helps prevent cavities.

phrases.example: 이 물에는 불소가 들어 있지 않아요.
phrases.en: This water does not contain fluoride.
phrases.nuance_ko: 제품에 성분이 있는지 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say whether a product contains this ingredient.

phrases.en: In chemistry class I also learned the name fluorine.
phrases.nuance_ko: 같은 원소를 가리키는 이름이에요. 화학에서 주로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Another name for the same element, mainly used in chemistry.

explain_en: In chemistry it names the element F, but in daily life you hear it most in talk about toothpaste and cavities. '플루오린' is another name for the same element. On toothpaste ingredient lists you may see it written as '불소'.

examples.en: Hunger and sleepiness are physiological needs of people.
I just instinctively can't stand cockroaches.
It's a natural bodily function, so don't be too embarrassed.

examples.ko: 오래 앉아 있으면 생리적 불편함이 생겨요.
examples.en: If you sit for a long time, you get physical discomfort.

examples.ko: 낯선 사람을 만날 때 땀이 나는 것은 생리적 반응일 뿐이에요.
examples.en: Sweating when you meet a stranger is just a physical reaction.
It was a bodily need, so it was hard to hold in.

explain: 몸이 작동하는 방식과 관련된 일에 쓰고, '생리적 욕구', '생리적 반응'이 대표적인 짝이에요. '생리적으로 싫다'는 이유를 설명하기 어렵고 몸이 먼저 거부하는 느낌일 때 쓰는 말이에요.

phrases.en: Sleep and food are basic physiological needs.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가장 대표적인 짝말이에요. 몸이 꼭 필요로 하는 것을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most typical pairing, for things the body needs.

phrases.example: 긴장하면 땀이 나는 것은 생리적 반응이에요.
phrases.en: Sweating when you're nervous is a physiological reaction.
phrases.nuance_ko: 몸이 저절로 보이는 반응을 설명할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to explain reactions the body has automatically.

phrases.en: I just instinctively hate bugs.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이유 없이 몸이 먼저 싫어할 때 쓰는 입말 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A spoken expression for when your body rejects something for no clear reason.

explain_en: It relates to how the body works, with '생리적 욕구' (physiological need) and '생리적 반응' as typical pairs. '생리적으로 싫다' means you dislike something so strongly that your body rejects it before you can explain why.

examples.ko: 동물원에서 가장 오래 산 코끼리가 자연사했어요.
examples.en: The longest-living elephant at the zoo died of natural causes.

examples.ko: 그 거북이는 백 살이 넘어서 자연사했대요.
examples.en: I heard that turtle died naturally after passing a hundred years old.

examples.ko: 숲에서 발견된 새는 자연사한 것으로 보여요.
examples.en: The bird found in the forest seems to have died of natural causes.
It's not common for wild animals to die of old age.

examples.ko: 조사 결과 그 고래들은 자연사한 것이 아니었어요.
examples.en: The investigation showed those whales had not died naturally.

examples.ko: 나이 든 사자가 우리 안에서 자연사했다고 해요.
examples.en: They say the old lion died naturally inside its enclosure.

explain: 사고나 병이 아니라 나이가 들어 자연스럽게 죽는 것을 말하고, 동물 뉴스에서 자주 나와요. 반대로 사고로 죽은 경우는 '사고사'라고 해요. '자연사'만 쓰면 '자연의 역사'라는 뜻일 수도 있어서 문맥을 봐야 해요.

phrases.en: We found an animal that died naturally in the forest.
phrases.nuance_ko: '자연사하다'를 앞에서 꾸미는 모양으로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The modifier form, placed before a noun.

phrases.en: I heard the old man died peacefully of natural causes.
phrases.nuance_ko: 남에게 들은 소식을 전할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to pass on news you heard from others.

phrases.example: 그 동물은 사고로 죽어서 자연사하지 않았어요.
phrases.en: That animal died in an accident, so it did not die a natural death.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사고사나 병사와 구별해서 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to distinguish from accidental or illness-related death.

explain_en: It means dying naturally of old age rather than from an accident or illness, and it often appears in animal news. A death by accident is called '사고사'. The bare noun '자연사' can also mean natural history, so check the context.

examples.ko: 동생이 태어나자 아이가 퇴행 행동을 보였어요.
examples.en: When the little brother was born, the child showed regressive behavior.
Joint degeneration begins as we get older.

examples.ko: 퇴행 현상은 스트레스 때문에 생기기도 해요.
examples.en: Regression can also be caused by stress.
I'm worried about the regression of talking like a baby again.
I go to the hospital because of degenerative arthritis.
Many people worry about the backsliding of democracy.

explain: 심리에서는 아이가 어린 시절의 행동으로 돌아가는 것, 의학에서는 '퇴행성 관절염'처럼 몸의 기능이 나빠지는 것을 말해요. '퇴보'와 비슷하지만 퇴행은 심리·의학 말로 자주 나와요.

phrases.example: 할머니는 퇴행성 관절염 때문에 무릎이 아프세요.
phrases.en: My grandmother has knee pain because of degenerative arthritis.
phrases.nuance_ko: 의학에서 몸의 기능이 점점 나빠지는 병 이름에 자주 붙어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often attached to illness names where body function worsens gradually.

phrases.en: Regressive behavior appeared when a younger sibling was born.
phrases.nuance_ko: 심리에서 아이가 어릴 때처럼 행동하는 것을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: In psychology, acting like a younger child again.

phrases.example: 나이가 들면 퇴행 현상이 생길 수 있어요.
phrases.en: Degenerative changes can occur as people get older.
phrases.nuance_ko: 몸이나 기능이 뒤로 가는 변화를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for changes where the body or function declines.

explain_en: In psychology it means a child going back to earlier behavior, and in medicine it means the body's function declining, as in '퇴행성 관절염'. It is close to '퇴보' (regress), but '퇴행' shows up often in psychology and medicine.

examples.en: When a younger sibling arrives, the oldest child sometimes regresses.

examples.ko: 아이가 갑자기 아기처럼 말해서 퇴행한 것 같아요.
examples.en: The child suddenly talked like a baby, so it seems he regressed.

examples.ko: 몸의 기능이 퇴행하지 않게 운동을 해요.
examples.en: I exercise so that my body's functions don't decline.
Even adults regress when they are under heavy stress.

examples.ko: 사회가 퇴행한다는 말이 나올 만큼 상황이 안 좋아요.
examples.en: Things are so bad that people say society is moving backward.

examples.ko: 아이가 퇴행하는 모습을 보여도 혼내지 마세요.
examples.en: Even if the child shows signs of regression, don't scold him.

explain: '아이가 퇴행하다', '사회가 퇴행하다'처럼 주어가 스스로 뒤로 가는 느낌이라 목적어를 받지 않아요. 반대말은 '발전하다', '성장하다'예요.

phrases.en: I'm worried because the child shows signs of regression.
phrases.nuance_ko: 동사를 명사 앞에 붙여 눈에 보이는 변화를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Uses the verb before a noun for a visible change.

phrases.example: 스트레스를 받아서 말투가 아기처럼 퇴행해 버렸어요.
phrases.en: Under stress, his way of talking regressed like a baby's.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-아/어 버리다'로 이미 그렇게 되어 아쉬운 느낌을 더해요.
phrases.nuance_en: '-아/어 버리다' adds a sense that it already happened, with some regret.

phrases.en: We should work so that society doesn't regress.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-지 않도록'으로 그렇게 되지 않게 하자는 목적을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: '-지 않도록' expresses the goal of preventing it.

explain_en: It describes the subject itself moving backward, as in '아이가 퇴행하다' or '사회가 퇴행하다', so it takes no object. Opposites are '발전하다' and '성장하다'.
